research_scope: Five skills confirmed as absent from the repository's live code-search index, researched against current Xenoverse 2 references.

verification_audit.source_policy: Repository search was performed for every selected skill before addition. Values are promoted only where the cited references establish them; conflicting Life Absorption measurements are retained as unresolved provenance.

records.name: Drain Charge
records.unlock_method: Skill Shop after The Galactic Emperor
records.source_quest_or_shop: Skill Shop after The Galactic Emperor
records.skill_description: A CaC-exclusive grab Super that steals Ki from the opponent.
records.mechanics_notes: The referenced skill page reports a neck grab that drains five Ki bars and gives the user five bars or fills the user's Ki regardless of the opponent's remaining Ki. Exact PvP/PvE edge cases remain outside this batch.
records.combo_notes: Grab-based and therefore requires the target to be in a state where a normal command grab can connect.

records.name: Hyper Drain
records.skill_description: A CaC-exclusive grab Super that steals both Ki and Stamina.
records.mechanics_notes: The current reference identifies Hyper Drain as a Strike Super and describes its purpose as stealing both Ki and Stamina. Exact amounts and detailed timing should be independently reconciled before promotion to verified.
records.combo_notes: Grab-based; exact interruption and target-state behavior remains a future mechanics audit.

records.name: Life Absorption
records.mechanics_notes: Current Fandom references agree on Strike Super classification, Cell (First Form) usage, 100 Ki, and CaC unavailability. Two current reference variants disagree on the amount drained: one reports 5% and another 10%. The canonical value is intentionally unresolved until game-data reconciliation.
records.combo_notes: Rear grab with short-range targeting; exact connection rules remain a technical research field.

records.name: Energy Release
records.unlock_method: Character-exclusive skill; current reference does not establish a CaC acquisition route
records.skill_description: A character-exclusive charge skill used by Towa.
records.mechanics_notes: The current reference classifies Energy Release as an Other Super and describes it as a slow charge comparable to Energy Charge, with Towa charging in place while holding her staff. Exact resource cost and acquisition are not asserted here.

records.name: Flash Bomber
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 95 — Super 17, the Ultimate Android
records.skill_description: A chargeable Ki Blast barrage that can be extended by spending additional Ki.
records.mechanics_notes: The current reference reports 21 hits and 15% damage at base, with up to 56 hits and 40% damage after an additional 200 Ki. The repository records the documented base 100 Ki cost and leaves the exact reward-slot semantics unresolved.
